claude_result_text: The 'engines_four_underwing' feature has been improved by adjusting the inboard and outboard engine spacing along the wing (Z-axis) to match the design reference ($|z| = 14.5$ and $|z| = 26$ respectively). This addresses the issue where engines appeared too close together or in counts of only two from certain profiles. The forward offsets on the X-axis were also slightly adjusted to maintain a realistic sweep profile relative to the wing root.
